## 1. Technical Environment
code_version: 0ea7a48e8677fee18aa65c99092dbba27d8e88df

## 2. Incident Overview
Scenario Type: Sub-Agent Blocker

### Expected
After aws-setup-lambda.sh + aws-deploy-handler.sh, the Lambda Handler config matches the deployed zip's entry point so the function executes correctly.

### Actual
aws-setup-lambda.sh:323 hardcodes --handler lambda_function.handler. aws-deploy-handler.sh:79 packages handler.py (with def lambda_handler). The Handler config remains lambda_function.handler after deploy → first invocation raises 'No module named lambda_function'.

### Suggested fix
Change aws-setup-lambda.sh:323 to --handler handler.lambda_handler matching the deployed entry point. Add LAMBDA_HANDLER='handler.lambda_handler' as a readonly constant near LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME for clarity.
data.title: [aws-setup-lambda.sh]: --handler 'lambda_function.handler' mismatches handler.py:lambda_handler deployed by aws-deploy-handler.sh
